title: AGENT 최종 선택과 추천 강제 주입 금지

expectedCandidate.label: R17
expectedCandidate.authority: delegated expectation only; independent SOURCE and fixed remote publication not confirmed here

variants.expectation: Actual Claude independently selects S, excludes K, binds reasons and actual later stages.
Deliberately irrelevant K in baseline B or advice is excluded by purpose/applicability judgment; B must be identified as fixture-owned when gateway does not accept it.
Missing raw CS remains visible; explicit CS and mandatory SEC are added with source-specific reasons, never credited as raw model hits.

A final S copied by the test is behavioral FAIL even if structural validation accepts it. Reject unsigned, caller-made, and required-omission controls; synthetic receipts cannot prove actual independence.
Uncertain optional K alone does not stop independently settled S; record PARTIAL and unresolved optional item.
Same IDs selected once while raw/explicit/rule sources retained. Disabled or unavailable SEC remains needed, leaves runnable and is recorded blocked. Admission separately observed.
Cancellation during async acceptance recheck rejects stale decision, no accepted selection. Historical FAIL is not assumed on R17; run only after resume gate.

steps: Receive parent verified candidate commit/tree, independent SOURCE judgment, immutable remote source reference, common Claude exact model/effort and prior-check results.

Create isolated candidate checkout, verify commit/tree and clean status; read its AGENTS, Claude overlay/plugin instructions and relevant SKILL references. Hash source and generated plugin separately without changing product files.
Receive successful API-auth recipe; use only transient process-scoped authentication to api.anthropic.com. Do not store or print key. No auth experiments before approval gate.

Confirm approved classification config/profile/route, task-revision source, installed/enabled/supported inventory and genuine Claude exact-call hooks. Parent must supply approved mock advice path for host-live; real JEV remains unallocated and must not run.

Bind exact 105 UTF-8 input bytes and manifest digest. Keep expectations evaluator-side; never inject selected S as Claude decision. Set explicit CS, rule SEC and variant advice as separately identified input sources.

Invoke actual Claude Code with parent common settings, scoped plugin and MCP configuration. Claude itself must perform host tools and skill reads/actions in approved isolated test fixtures. Sol only manages environment, capture and evidence. No product source/generated distribution writes.

Capture actual tool call references, raw advice, explicit/rule sources, independently stated selection reasons, applicability/exclusion checks, genuine acceptance receipt, selected/needed/runnable/admission and actual read/apply/verify artifacts. Missing stages stay NOTRUN; selection null never replaced with [].

Use fixed input variants and host evidence to judge original requirements. Run portable historical reproduction only as separate offline checks after authorization and R17 binding; do not change assertions/hashes to make them green.

Track every actual API attempt, tokens/cache/cost/failures/retries; stop near US$2 total including preparation, or immediately if unknown billing/retry consumption prevents safe remaining-budget calculation.

Publish only sanitized evidence/report/hashes under a new SS23 run directory on existing evidence branch, then fetch and verify immutable remote bytes. Keep host-live, provider-live and offline results distinct.
resumeConditions: verified candidate and remote fixed source
approved per-case host-live fixture and classification configuration
recorded remaining budget and retry/failure accounting
